channel.title: GatorBait Media
channel.description: GatorBait Media is the premier source for Florida Gators news, founded by Emmy-winning journalist and NY Times best-selling author Buddy Martin. Covering UF athletics since 1979. Home of The Buddy Martin Show (LIVE Mon-Thu 9PM ET on YouTube and Facebook). In-depth reporting from Buddy Martin, Franz Beard, Carlton Reese, and the GatorBait team. Football, basketball, baseball, recruiting, transfer portal, gymnastics, softball, and every Gator sport. Photography by Chris Spears. Produced by Brenden Martin.

item.title: Florida is one win from bowl eligibility, with a bye before Georgia
item.description: The Gators (5-2, 3-2 SEC) need six wins for a bowl game, have five games left and are off Oct. 24 before Georgia in Atlanta on Oct. 31.
item.dc:creator: Brenden Martin

item.title: Longhorns Tumble, Gators Return: Florida Is No. 20 In The AP Poll
item.description: Florida is back in the AP Top 25 at No. 20 after beating No. 7 Texas, which fell to No. 19. Miami is No. 1, and Georgia, Florida's Oct. 31 opponent, is No. 5.
item.dc:creator: Brenden Martin

item.title: Deep In The Heart Of Texas, A Gator Grin. A Song. And The Sigh “We’re Back!”
item.description: Buddy Martin: There are worse ways to spend a Saturday than beating Texas in Austin while Texas A&M fans do the Gator Chomp. However, let’s maybe not order the commemorative plates yet.
item.dc:creator: Buddy Martin

item.title: Postgame Thoughts: Florida (5-2, 3-2) v. Texas (4-2, 1-2)
item.description: Florida finds a way to get out of Austin with a win on a day where they continue to find more about themselves every day. Loren Meadows breaks down what we thought, what we got and what it means.
item.dc:creator: Loren Meadows

item.title: The Gators Sucked Less, Turning Arch Madness Into Arch Sadness
item.description: Franz Beard: A bye week, a quarterback question and a defense that found its fight in Austin. Plus every SEC result: Auburn stuns No. 1 Georgia, Tennessee routs Alabama and more.
item.dc:creator: Franz Beard

item.title: A Texas Barbecue: Gators Flip The Script — And Jones Changes The Conversation
item.description: Buddy Martin on Florida's 27-24 win at No. 7 Texas, Tramell Jones Jr.'s first start and the quarterback question Jon Sumrall now faces.
item.dc:creator: Buddy Martin

item.title: It was a good day for an exorcism in Austin
item.description: Franz Beard: Florida's defense found its inner Doomsday, Arch Manning got haunted and Tramell Jones Jr. won his first start on the road, 27-24 at No. 7 Texas.
item.dc:creator: Franz Beard

item.title: Gators Stun No. 7 Texas 27-24 in Austin Behind Jones Jr.
item.description: AUSTIN, Texas — Florida walked into Darrell K Royal–Texas Memorial Stadium on Saturday with a backup quarterback making his first career start, fell behind 17-3, and walked out with the win of its season. The Gators (5-2, 3-2 SEC) scored 24 straight points and held on to beat No. 7 Texas 27-24, sealed late when Myles Graham sacked Arch Manning and knocked the ball loose, and Kanye Clark fell on it at the Texas 39. Tramell Jones Jr. got the start with Aaron Philo out and played every snap. His...
item.dc:creator: Brenden Martin

item.title: Aberdeen will be in the lineup against Baylor on Sunday
item.description: Franz Beard: Denzel Aberdeen starts Sunday when preseason No. 1 Florida opens with a Baylor exhibition in Jacksonville, and his fifth-year case should hold up. Plus SEC coaches on the NCAA and 11 international recruits to watch.
item.dc:creator: Franz Beard

item.title: Is the SEC undergoing a drain of excellence?
item.description: Parody or parity? Buddy Martin on a 24-team playoff and an SEC that hasn’t lost excellence so much as its monopoly on it. Me, I worry that the scavengers have come for what’s left of college football.
item.dc:creator: Buddy Martin

item.title: The Soothsayer: Texas big unless the UF defense finds an exorcist
item.description: Franz Beard: Florida is the man with the rope around his neck and Texas is the jukebox. The Soothsayer on Tramell Jones Jr.’s first start, Will Muschamp’s defense, an 11.5-point line and every SEC game Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Franz Beard

item.title: Watch the Replay: Buddy Martin's Philo Injury Exclusive, With Chris Doering
item.description: The Buddy Martin Show is live at 9 p.m. ET with the Philo-or-Jones question ahead of Florida at No. 7 Texas. Watch on the show page or YouTube.
item.dc:creator: Brenden Martin

item.title: QB1 Philo Hurt. QB2 Jones To Start? Explained by That Great Football Mind Ted Lasso
item.description:
Buddy Martin called in the two greatest minds he knows, Albert Einstein and Ted Lasso, to explain Jon Sumrall's reverse thermostat, why calm is not surrender, and why Gator fans might not be crazy for believing. Members, the biscuits are inside.
Einstein had relativity. Ted Lasso has biscuits. And an amazing attitude. So does Tramell Jones.
item.dc:creator: Buddy Martin

item.title: So You're Saying There's a Chance!?
item.description: Well, the low scoring Longhorns have their struggles, too. Facing the Texas Longhorns on the road in Austin is a tough task for a team that hasn't played well in the last two weeks. The Gators hit the road as a 10.5-point underdog. item.description: Aaron Philo was limited at practice Wednesday, according to On3. Tramell Jones Jr. would be next in line if Philo cannot play.

item.title: Philo is the Florida quarterback at least for now
item.description: Because it is universally described as the single most important position in all of team sports, when it comes to football fingers immediately point to the quarterback whenever things go south, which they have the last two weeks for the Florida Gators (4-2, 2-2 SEC). Aaron Philo, whose numbers were just a shade under brilliant in Florida's 4-0 September have taken a serious plunge in losses to Missouri and South Carolina. item.title: Numbers Don't Lie
item.description: Florida and South Carolina were nearly even in first downs and yards, but the Gators lost 38-19. Eddie Gilley on the three turnovers and two short fields behind a statistical draw.
